comment: Seeds every pull request runs. Append any seed the extended suite fails on (CONFORMANCE_SEEDS=1-500), with a note, so it stays a regression test.

regressions.note: A stream that trickled bytes without completing a frame kept the Flutter client attached (liveness counted bytes); now counts complete frames, as the JS SDKs do.

R20: a stream replay read before a poll but delivered after it rolled the polled flags back at 'ready'. Fixed by revisioned snapshots (?v=2) and the per-flag merge at 'ready'; deterministic form: named scenario 'a delayed replay does not roll back newer polled flags (R20, seed 173)'.
R20: the same sequence brought back a flag deleted meanwhile. Deterministic form: named scenario 'a delayed replay does not resurrect a flag deleted meanwhile (R20, seed 184)'.
